source_review.notes: Reviewed MIT augmentation lectures, CMU and Stanford augmented-BST material, Princeton rank/select implementation and checks, current GCC policy/implementation sources, current Linux augmented-rbtree callbacks, and current ISO C++ associative requirements. All ten final destinations returned HTTP 200; one stale indexed CMU URL was replaced before review.

Checked unique-key, physical-occurrence, multiplicity, and arbitrary-weight conventions are not mixed.

Reproduced all selections and ranks 0:0,1:0,4:3,5:4,9:8,10:9 plus [3,8) count five.
Reproduced deletion of 4 returning FOUR and yielding root 5, size eight, height four, six cumulative rotations.
Recomputed post-delete select(4)=6, rank(6)=4, and [3,8) count four.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts describe the finite unique-integer AVL history only.

evidence: Verified select's residual-index invariant and rank's skipped-prefix invariant for present and absent keys.
Verified rank/select inversion and half-open range difference under strict lower-bound rank.
Verified left/right rotation size algebra and demoted-before-promoted dependency order.
Verified complexity is O(h) and logarithmic only under the separately maintained base-tree guarantee.

Checked rank(select(i)) for all legal indices before and after deletion and compared all printed ranks/ranges with sorted order.
